component.responsibility: Read arguments, orchestrate the flow and return the exit code.
Read the CSV, validate columns and rows, convert amounts to cents.
component.owned_data: Accepted-rows table and rejected-rows table, in memory.
component.failure_behaviour: Missing columns or unreadable file: code 2; bad row: rejected.

component.responsibility: Five pure functions, one per test, that receive the validated table and return alerts in the common format.
component.failure_behaviour: Benford with too few rows does not run and says so.

component.responsibility: Join the alerts into a single format. Lives in the checks module.
component.failure_behaviour: Fails only through a programming error.

component.responsibility: Write results.xlsx with 8 sheets, tables, formulas and the Benford chart.
component.failure_behaviour: Unwritable folder, locked output file or too many rows for one sheet: code 1, no half-written file.

spec.module: content.py holds the strings of the content file as Python constants; a test keeps the two equal.
spec.private_component: Synthetic data generator: outside the public repository, in a private project reused by the machine learning project.

data_flow.flow: Accepted rows to the five tests.
Alerts to the aggregator and then to the Excel writer.

stack.item: Python 3.11 or later; versions pinned in constraints.txt, with python_version markers for NumPy and SciPy.
XlsxWriter: tables, formulas and native chart.
pytest, ruff and openpyxl (only to read results.xlsx in tests): tests and style.

spec.external_services: None. The network is used only by CI and by package installation.
spec.folder_structure: src/journal_entry_tests (cli, validation, checks, excel_writer, content), tests and tests/fixtures, spec, context, data, .github/workflows.
spec.scaling_limits: Designed and tested for up to 100000 rows in memory; no hard limit is enforced on the input and larger files are untested. A workbook sheet holds at most 1048573 table rows; above that the run stops with code 1.
spec.logging_alerting: Errors on stderr and the final result line on stdout; no log files and no alerting.
spec.rollback: Revert the commit or delete the release tag on GitHub.
